INVESTIGATION DEAD-END WARNING — the cited defect does NOT exist on origin/main.

`src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py` does not exist on origin/main at all. A grep of main for the symbol `warn_if_cache_ineffective` and for the warning's user-visible text ('caching requested but had NO effect') returns zero hits in `src/`.

The defect lives only on the epic 061c feature branches — `feat/llm-provider-seam`, `feat/cb6f-pointer`, `feat/cc33-fallback`. On `feat/llm-provider-seam`:
- `warn_if_cache_ineffective` is defined at `src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py:166`
- it is called from `src/rebar/llm/runner.py:552`
- it is documented in `src/rebar/llm/anthropic/bedrock_model.py:23`

So 7a79 was reported against UNLANDED epic work, not against main. The ticket's cited path is not stale — it is ahead of main. Do not search main for it.

Consequence for whoever picks this up: this must be worked on the 061c feature branch that owns those files, in coordination with the session holding that surface, not as an independent change against main. The `CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS = 4096` constant referenced by the plan DOES exist on main at `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py:49`, so the 'one shared definition' acceptance criterion spans a file on main and a file that only exists on the feature branch.

Also note: this ticket's signed plan-review PASS attestation is pinned at `verified-at-sha:8d482f4a91491c501f69416bc43d765f9a6d0919`; check currency with `rebar review-plan 7a79-a920-afe7-40cf --status` before relying on it.
